subject: bearded vulture
title: This Vulture Lives on Bones, and It Has a Brutal Trick

scenes.text: There's a vulture that lives almost entirely on bones. But it can't crack them.
It's the bearded vulture, also called the lammergeier, and bone can be up to ninety percent of its diet.
So it carries a bone high into the air, and lets go.
The bone smashes on the rocks below, and the bird swoops down to eat the pieces.
What it swallows, it digests. Its stomach acid is close to pure hydrochloric acid, with a pH around zero point seven.
Mastering the drop can take years. A bird that eats skeletons, with a stomach to match.

description:
There's a vulture that lives almost entirely on bones, but it can't crack them.
The bearded vulture drops bones onto rocks from the air, then digests the pieces with stomach acid close to pure hydrochloric acid.
Would you have guessed a bird could eat bones?
first_comment: Bones for breakfast, lunch and dinner. Which animal's diet surprised you most?
